# Data preparation


## Read and proprecess data
```{r}
source("load_data.R")
```

```{r}
# --- Helper Function to Calculate Shannon Entropy ---
# This converts continuous ratings into discrete probability distributions for entropy
calc_shannon <- function(x) {
  # Assuming ratings are integers or can be grouped into 1-7 levels
  p <- table(factor(x, levels = 1:7)) / length(x)
  p <- p[p > 0] # Remove zero probabilities to avoid log(0)
  return(-sum(p * log(p)))
}
```

```{r}
# --- Define the dimensions of interest ---
dims <- c("Hominess", "Naturalness", "Personalness", "Beauty", "Approachability", "mean_rating")


# Entropy within each subject across different images
df_subject_entropy <- df %>%
  group_by(Participant, Group, Category) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(dims), list(mean = mean, ent = calc_shannon), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"), .groups = 'drop')


# Entropy across different subjects for the same image
df_item_entropy <- df %>%
  group_by(ImageNumber, Group, Category) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(dims), list(mean = mean, ent = calc_shannon), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"), .groups = 'drop')
```


# ANOVA

```{r}
# ---  Function: analyze_variability (Dual Compatibility with 3-decimal formatting) ---
analyze_variability <- function(data, dv, dv_label) {
  
  # --- 1. Identify Data Level and Structure ---
  if("Participant" %in% names(data)) {
    id_var <- "Participant"
    between_var <- "Group"
    within_var <- "Category"
    data_type <- "Subject-level"
  } else if("ImageID" %in% names(data) | "ImageNumber" %in% names(data)) {
    id_var <- if("ImageID" %in% names(data)) "ImageID" else "ImageNumber"
    between_var <- "Category"
    within_var <- "Group"
    data_type <- "Item-level"
  } else {
    stop("Data must contain either 'Participant' or 'ImageID/ImageNumber'.")
  }

  cat(paste0("\n\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n"))
  cat(paste0("ANALYZING ", data_type, ": ", dv, "\n"))
  cat(paste0(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n"))

  # --- 2. Run Mixed-Design ANOVA ---
  anova_res <- aov_ez(id = id_var, 
                      dv = dv, 
                      data = data, 
                      between = between_var, 
                      within = within_var)
  
  cat("\n--- ANOVA Results (with Partial Eta Squared) ---\n")
  # Use capture.output and custom formatting if needed, 
  # or simply use print with digits = 3
  print(anova_res, es = "pes", digits = 3)
  
  # --- 3. Post-hoc Comparisons & Cohen's d ---
  emm <- emmeans(anova_res, ~ Group | Category)
  post_hoc_summary <- summary(pairs(emm, reverse = TRUE, adjust = "tukey"), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
  
  mse <- anova_res$anova_table$MSE[1]
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(mse)
  
  # --- Apply 3-decimal formatting to the reporting table ---
  reporting_table <- post_hoc_summary %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% # Ensure it's a dataframe for mutation
    mutate(cohens_d = estimate / pooled_sd) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))) %>% # Round all numeric columns
    select(Category, contrast, estimate, SE, df, lower.CL, upper.CL, t.ratio, p.value, cohens_d)
  
  cat("\n--- Post-hoc Comparisons (Control - ASD) & Cohen's d ---\n")
  # Use print.data.frame to ensure the rounding is respected in output
  print(as.data.frame(reporting_table), digits = 3)
  
  # --- 4. Visualization ---
  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Category, y = .data[[dv]], fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, width = 0.5, position = position_dodge(0.6)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = Group), 
                position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.6), 
                alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("ASD" = "#E64B35FF", "Neurotypical" = "#4DBBD5FF")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("ASD" = "#E64B35FF", "Neurotypical" = "#4DBBD5FF")) +
    labs(y = dv_label, x = "Category", title = paste(data_type, "Analysis:", dv)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top", axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  print(plot)
  
  return(list(anova = anova_res, post_hoc = reporting_table, plot = plot))
}
```


```{r}
# List of all Entropy columns in the subject_entropy dataframe
target_cols <- c("Hominess_ent", "Naturalness_ent", "Personalness_ent", "Beauty_ent", "Approachability_ent")

# Loop through each and generate reports
for(col in target_cols) {
  analyze_variability(df_subject_entropy, col, paste("Entropy of", gsub("_ent", "", col)))
}
```



```{r}
# Item-level entropy
for(col in target_cols) {
  analyze_variability(df_item_entropy, col, paste("Entropy of", gsub("_ent", "", col)))
}
```
In each ASD-CTRL comparison, the entropy of ASD group is higher. 



# Combined plot
## Entropy
```{r}
# --- Function: plot_combined_entropy ---
# Generates a 2x3 grid with 5 subplots (Excluding Mean)
plot_combined_entropy <- function(data) {
  library(tidyverse)
  library(stringr)
  
  # 1. Identify ID variable: Subject-level (Participant) or Item-level (ImageNumber)
  id_var <- if("Participant" %in% names(data)) "Participant" else "ImageNumber"
  
  # 2. Define 5 raw aesthetic dimensions (Excluding Mean)
  dims <- c("Hominess", "Naturalness", "Personalness", "Beauty", "Approachability")
  raw_cols <- paste0(dims, "_ent")
  
  # 3. Pivot to long format
  df_long <- data %>%
    select(any_of(id_var), Group, Category, all_of(raw_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(raw_cols),
      names_to = "Dimension",
      values_to = "Value"
    ) %>%
    # Dynamically remove suffix for clean labels
    mutate(Dimension = factor(Dimension, levels = raw_cols, labels = dims))
  
  # 4. Generate the plot
  ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Category, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6, width = 0.5, position = position_dodge(0.6)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = Group), 
                position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.6), 
                alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~Dimension, nrow = 2, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("ASD" = "#E64B35FF", "Neurotypical" = "#4DBBD5FF")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("ASD" = "#E64B35FF", "Neurotypical" = "#4DBBD5FF")) +
    labs(
      y = "Shannon Entropy (Bits)",
      x = "Category",
      title = paste("Rating Uncertainty (Entropy):", 
                   ifelse(id_var == "Participant", "Subject-level", "Item-level"))
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"), 
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14)
    )
}
```

```{r}
# load ASD clinical info
ASD_info <- read_excel("Participant_infos.xlsx", sheet = 'ASD')
# --- 1. Clean the original dataset ---
# Convert character-based missing value placeholders to true R NA
# and ensure columns are in the correct data format.
asd_clean <- ASD_info %>%
  mutate(
    # Rename and convert Patient ID
    Participant = as.numeric(`elenco pazienti`),
    
    # Clean and convert IQ column
    IQ = ifelse(QI %in% c("Waiting for the data", "\\", "NA"), NA, QI),
    IQ = as.numeric(IQ),
    
    # Clean and convert ADOS column
    ADOS = ifelse(ADOS %in% c("Waiting for the data", "\\", "NA"), NA, ADOS),
    ADOS = as.numeric(ADOS)
  )

# --- 2. Extract the Participant and IQ DataFrame ---
df_iq <- asd_clean %>%
  select(Participant, IQ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Participant)) # Remove rows without a valid participant ID

# --- 3. Extract the Participant and ADOS DataFrame ---
df_ados <- asd_clean %>%
  select(Participant, ADOS) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Participant)) # Remove rows without a valid participant ID

# --- 4. Verify the results ---
print("IQ DataFrame Structure:")
str(df_iq)

print("ADOS DataFrame Structure:")
str(df_ados)
```
```{r}
library(ggpubr)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare and Reshape the Entropy Dataset
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_cols <- c("Hominess_ent", "Naturalness_ent", "Personalness_ent", "Beauty_ent", "Approachability_ent")

df_entropy_long <- df_subject_entropy %>%
  select(Participant, Group, Category, all_of(target_cols)) %>%
  filter(Group == "ASD") %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(target_cols),
    names_to = "Dimension",
    values_to = "Entropy"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Dimension = sub("_ent$", "", Dimension))

# Force "Plus" to be on the first row and "Minus" on the second row
df_entropy_long$Category <- factor(df_entropy_long$Category, levels = c("Plus", "Minus"))

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Merge with Clinical (ADOS) and Cognitive (IQ) Data
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_analysis_ados <- df_entropy_long %>%
  inner_join(df_ados, by = "Participant") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ADOS))

df_analysis_iq <- df_entropy_long %>%
  inner_join(df_iq, by = "Participant") %>%
  filter(!is.na(IQ))

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Plot 1: ADOS vs. Entropy (2 x 5 Grid)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
plot_ados <- ggplot(df_analysis_ados, aes(x = ADOS, y = Entropy)) +
  geom_point(color = "#E64B35FF", alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkgray", fill = "lightgray", size = 0.4) +
  # Decreased size to 2.8 to prevent text clipping in small facets
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top", size = 2.8) +
  facet_grid(Category ~ Dimension, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation between ADOS Scores and Subject-level Entropy (ASD Group)",
    x = "ADOS Score",
    y = "Shannon Entropy (Bits)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    title = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),          # Decreased facet label font size
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),          # Decreased axis title font size
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7.5),         # Decreased axis tick labels to prevent overlap
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, face = "bold")
  )

print(plot_ados)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Plot 2: IQ vs. Entropy (2 x 5 Grid)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
plot_iq <- ggplot(df_analysis_iq, aes(x = IQ, y = Entropy)) +
  geom_point(color = "#3C5488FF", alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkgray", fill = "lightgray", size = 0.4) +
  # Decreased size to 2.8 to prevent text clipping in small facets
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top", size = 2.8) +
  facet_grid(Category ~ Dimension, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation between IQ and Subject-level Entropy (ASD Group)",
    x = "IQ Score",
    y = "Shannon Entropy (Bits)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    title = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),          # Decreased facet label font size
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),          # Decreased axis title font size
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7.5),         # Decreased axis tick labels to prevent overlap
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, face = "bold")
  )

print(plot_iq)
```
